title: AI text-assistant release-gate and operational review
summary: Completed comprehensive release-gate and operational review of Ask Nori text-assistant. Enhanced discoverability on web with prominent sidebar and header entry points while presenting truthful gated banners under DEF-V2-008. Verified proposal review flow with editable previews, ambiguous date clarification questions (preventing hallucinations for relative dates), explicit Save/Confirm requirement, durable sync mutation receipts, and canonical deep links. Separated mock provider evaluation from live wire protocol evaluation with store: false, error mapping, and cancellation fencing. Gated fail-closed pending enterprise privacy authorization.

gatesChecked.DEF-V2-008: BLOCKED (requires enterprise provider privacy authorization & commercial contract; fail-closed)
gatesChecked.vaultExclusion: PASSED (unconditional exclusion of vault items and keys)
gatesChecked.journalOptIn: PASSED (strict opt-in required to propose or index journals)
gatesChecked.antiHallucinationDateAmbiguity: PASSED (clarification prompts required for relative dates)
gatesChecked.canonicalDeepLinks: PASSED (getOrganizerDeepLink verified for tasks, notes, journals)
